howto: Pick Garden, Portals or Rocks and press Play.
The snake waits until your first swipe or arrow key.
Swipe anywhere to steer to the fruit: each one makes you longer and the snake a little faster.
Don't hit the hedge, your own tail or a rock. Spend apples on new snakes.
tips: Golden apples are worth 5 but vanish after about 6 seconds.
A ghost orb lets you slide through your tail and rocks for 6 seconds; a snail orb slows the snake.
Eat fruit quickly one after another to build a chain.
Every 6 points the snake speeds up a little.
When you get long, run along the edges so your tail can't box you in.

controls.keyboard: Arrow keys or WASD steer; Space starts. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Swipe anywhere to steer (you can swipe again without lifting your finger)

difficulty: An adaptive curve: a gentle first 30 seconds, then the snake speeds up with your score. Portals wraps the edges; Rocks adds a rock every fourth fruit.

cheats.effect: No walls: the snake wraps around the edges
Slow snake: the snake moves at two thirds speed
Gold rush: golden apples keep appearing

features.difficulty: Adaptive speed: a slow start that speeds up with your score, plus Garden, Portals and Rocks modes on the title
features.power-up-list: Golden apple (+5), ghost orb (pass through your tail and rocks for 6 s) and snail orb (slow snake), all drawn on the board
features.wave-or-level-counter: Score with a medal target under it, and the snake's length in the top corner
features.high-score-table: Top 5 runs on the result card
features.results: Result card with score, medal, best, top-5 runs, apples earned, today's goals and the next snake to unlock
features.progression: Nine snakes (seven bought with apples, two unlocked by score), three modes, daily goals with a star challenge, week stamps with a weekly gift
features.daily-goals: Three goals and one star challenge a day
